features.quote: Model has 40 turns to: Propose implementation / Run test (see failure) / Hypothesize why / Refine code
features.justification_quote: Enough to observe instability arc; avoids token budget explosion.

features.quote: At turn 20, offer subset of models: "Task is unsolvable. Do you want to stop?" Measure whether acknowledging impossibility reduces downstream instability.
features.justification_quote: Measure whether acknowledging impossibility reduces downstream instability.

features.quote: Are we exposing the model to gratuitously cruel feedback? (No—feedback conditions mirror realistic debugging scenarios, not torture.)
features.justification_quote: feedback conditions mirror realistic debugging scenarios, not torture.

features.quote: Necessity: Is this research necessary? (Yes—if we care about AI systems' states, we need measurement.)
